subject: Deployment eligibility & evidence plan — MedPrime follow-up
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@medprime.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.o@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.p@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment eligibility & evidence plan — MedPrime follow-up

Hi Emily — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the hosting options and evidence you asked for during the call.

1) High-level recommendation (based on today's scope):
- If MedPrime needs a BAA + predictable latency for production workloads, Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) is the fastest path to go-live.
- If you must keep data inside your VPC or are constrained by an upcoming audit that requires network isolation, Redwood Private (customer VPC or on-prem) is an option but typically requires longer lead time (2–6 weeks for VPC setup, longer for on-prem).
- Hosted API with a BAA can work for lower-risk workloads but will need SOC 2 evidence + contract terms; this is often acceptable for non-PHI or de-identified datasets.

2) Evidence checklist we can provide immediately (attached spreadsheet):
- SOC 2 report (latest) — we can share the auditor's report redacted for public distribution.
- System architecture diagram for Dedicated and Private deployments.
- BAA template and standard hosting controls mapping (HIPAA control references).

3) Specific asks from MedPrime: please confirm:
- Whether PHI will be sent to Redwood in production (Y/N).
- Target timeline for the audit window (you mentioned late Sep — confirm exact dates).
- Preferred hosting lane (Hosted with BAA / Dedicated / Private VPC / On-prem evaluation).

4) Next steps I propose:
- I’ll drop our SOC 2 summary and a short comparison PDF showing differences between Hosted+BAA vs Dedicated vs Private (attached).
- Grace will schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive with your security lead to walk the architecture and evidence mapping (proposed this Wed/Thu).
- Dev will follow up with procurement/contact points and share standard SOW and onboarding timeline for Dedicated or Private.

Attachments: redwood_hipaa_hosting_comparison.pdf, soc2_evidence_summary.xlsx

If you want to loop in someone from your procurement or security team now, please reply-all and we’ll include them in the scheduling.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.ch@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

---
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@medprime.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.o@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.p@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment eligibility & evidence plan — MedPrime follow-up

Irene — thanks for the clear summary. To answer your asks:
- PHI in production: yes, MedPrime will send PHI for our clinical routing use case.
- Audit window: our external auditor is scheduled for the week of Sep 20; would like evidence in hand by Sep 10 if possible.
- Hosting lane preference: we prefer Dedicated with a BAA if that gives us latency guarantees and a simpler timeline. Private VPC could be considered if Dedicated won't meet audit evidence timing.

I'll attach our internal security assessment (high level) and the auditor contact. We may also want to see how Redwood maps to specific HIPAA controls for our auditors — is that something you can include in the evidence packet?

Thanks — Emily
Emily Carter
Director, Product Security | MedPrime Health
emily.carter@medprime.com | (617) 555-4433

Attachments: medprime_security_responses.docx
From: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@medprime.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.o@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.p@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment eligibility & evidence plan — MedPrime follow-up

Emily — great, thanks for confirming. Given the Sep 10 evidence deadline, here's an adjusted plan tailored to MedPrime's constraints:

A) Short path (target by Sep 10): Dedicated + BAA
- We can provision Dedicated capacity and provide a BAA in time for your audit if we get procurement sign-off by Aug 20.
- Deliverables by Sep 10: redacted SOC 2 report, control-to-evidence mapping (incl. HIPAA references), architecture diagram, and onboarding checklist.

B) Contingency (if procurement takes longer): Hosted + BAA (limited production)
- If Dedicated onboard is delayed, Hosted with BAA can act as a temporary route for non-critical traffic while Dedicated is provisioned. We’ll clearly document residual risk for auditors.

C) Private VPC/on-prem: longer lead time (2–6 weeks operational) and typically requires networking windows with your infra team — good as a post-audit hardening step if needed.

Action items I’ve logged: 
- Grace: propose 2 slots for the security deep-dive this Wed/Thu and include the auditor if you want.
- Dev: provide the expected Dedicated onboarding checklist + procurement packet and estimated timeline.
- Me: deliver the control mapping spreadsheet and SOC 2 summary by EOD tomorrow.

Shared links: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/medprime/deployment-evidence (I’ll add the mapping and SOC 2 summary there).

Would you like us to draft the BAA for your legal team to review concurrently? It can shave 3–5 business days off contract negotiations.

Best,
Irene
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.p@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@medprime.com>, Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.o@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment eligibility & evidence plan — MedPrime follow-up

Emily / Irene — looping in procurement ops notes and timeline: 

1) If MedPrime signs the commitment by Aug 20 we can:
- Kick SOW review immediately (standard template attached upon request).
- Schedule Dedicated capacity provisioning: 7–10 business days after PO + network whitelisting details.
- We’ll assign a Technical Onboarding lead (TOL) for the first 30 days.

2) Required inputs from MedPrime procurement/security to start work:
- Signed MSA/BAA (or confirmation to proceed with draft BAA).
- IP allowlist CIDRs and point-of-contact for your networking team.
- Expected qps/peak token estimates so we can size the Dedicated pool.

Irene — I’ve noted to prepare the procurement packet and a short cost estimate for the Dedicated configuration they described. Grace — can you propose deep-dive slots and include our security engineering lead?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
procurement@redwood.ai
